description: Phase 1 performance budgets for the Architech public prototype. Re-baselined 26 Aug 2026 after the locality-intelligence layer added a provenance-labeled evidence band (current price range, inventory by configuration & budget, commute/nearby, new projects) to the /buy/ahmedabad/:locality/ hub, replacing placeholder snapshot figures for a cross-route client component: first-load gzip cap raised to 240 KB and total static JS cap to 2.16 MiB (max measured /search first-load gzip 230.0 KiB, total static JS 2151.1 KiB), keeping headroom so genuine regressions are still caught. Per-route raw first-load and core-web-vital targets remain unchanged. Prior re-baselines: 25 Aug 2026 parity overlay (first-load gzip 235 KB, total 2.15 MiB).
